versions.notes: Initial versioned release with auto-update checks
Detect overlapping Claude sessions (warning at startup, note at exit, marker in --stats), add macOS sound support, and use os.tmpdir() for cross-platform temp files (Linux, WSL, macOS).
Add --no-noop and --noop-threshold flags to exclude long idle/typing pauses (e.g. waiting for budget replenishment) from stats.
Pro-rate session times to queried date range. Sessions spanning midnight no longer inflate single-day stats with time from other days.
Show per-day breakdown in multi-day date range stats (e.g. --stats week, --stats DATE1 DATE2).
Detect stalled sessions (e.g. budget limit, network disconnect) after 60 minutes of no PTY output. Timer stops and work is counted only up to the last observed activity.
Add --tasks command: correlate git commit history with session logs to estimate per-task development time. Supports merge-based and linear repos, with --export-md for markdown output.

Fix inflated stats: agent_stop/agent_stall/typing_stall with agent_work_ms=0 now correctly transition phase to idle, preventing overnight sessions from being counted as agent work. Also cap standalone task window lookback to 2 hours.
Resolve cleaned-up worktree sessions to their parent git repo, so work done in worktrees is attributed to the correct project and task windows.

Extend task windows backward using session event data. From each task's first commit, walks back through the session to session_start, trimming at any idle gap >1h. Dramatically improves attribution for work-then-commit patterns.

Detect parallel tasks (overlapping commit windows) and show both per-task effort and wall-clock deduplicated totals. Terminal output marks parallel tasks and shows overlap. Markdown export includes dual tables: per-task effort and wall-clock allocation with parallel tasks combined.

Update checks are now opt-in. On first interactive run, claude-timed asks whether to check for new versions on startup; the answer is saved to settings.json (repo root, or ~/.claude/timings/ if globally installed). Edit that file to change the preference later.
Detect 'out of extra usage' limit from Claude Code output. Stops the agent timer immediately instead of waiting for the 120-minute stall timeout or process exit.

Fix state machine: add typing idle timeout (5 min), PAUSED state to cap idle gaps, and alive-check stall detection. Prevents overnight idle from being counted as work or typing, and avoids false stall when agent process is still alive.
Add --repair command to fix old sessions with oversized idle/typing gaps (caps to 5 min, inserts synthetic pause/resume events, recomputes totals). Backs up originals to .bak files.
Extended repair to also cap oversized background_agent_stop.agent_work_ms and session_end residuals. --tasks now shows idle/typing/agent breakdown per task.

Inspect the [unattributed] bucket in --tasks. New --unattributed-prompts lists every prompt that falls outside all task windows (with per-prompt agent/user time, git branch, and a reconciliation line vs the residual). New --attribute-llm uses a headless 'claude -p' call to thematically map those prompts to existing tasks (display-only). Opt-in forward prompt capture (--capture-prompts, or --enable-prompt-capture to persist) records prompt text in the timing log; otherwise text is resolved from Claude's transcripts. Agent time is never no-op'd.
When prompt capture is enabled, the wrapper now prints a privacy reminder at the start of every session (prompt text is being saved to the timing log) along with the command to disable it.

--attribute-llm now reports a clear status: whether the LLM ran (✓) or not (✗ with the reason, e.g. auth error), how many prompts it matched to how many tasks/commits, and how many prompts had no recoverable text. Matched tasks now show their commit hash. The status is printed at the top of the section so it isn't buried under the prompt list.

Fix --attribute-llm auth and parsing. A stale/placeholder ANTHROPIC_API_KEY shadows Claude OAuth and causes a 401; the headless call now retries with the key stripped so OAuth login is used. Also robustly parse the model's JSON answer when it is wrapped in markdown code fences or surrounded by prose.

Fix --attribute-llm ETIMEDOUT. The headless classification call now runs with --strict-mcp-config and --no-session-persistence so a slow/hanging MCP server can't stall startup (classification needs no tools), and the timeout is raised to 240s. Clearer timeout message.

Add --attribute-debug to diagnose LLM attribution: prints per-attempt timing, env/auth state, the exact claude command, and the claude --debug trace (via --debug-file) to stderr — so you can see where a slow/hanging headless call stalls. Add --attribute-timeout SEC to fail fast. Default attribution model is now 'haiku' (faster and cheaper for classification; override with --attribute-model sonnet).

--attribute-llm now chunks prompts into batches (60 per headless call) so large windows can't blow the timeout (time-to-first-token grows with payload size). Auth retry happens once and is reused across batches; transient spawn failures (ENOENT/EAGAIN) are retried with back-off; partial results are kept and reported if some batches fail. The status line now shows the model actually used.
